South of Thais there is a suspicious raft guarded by {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. On top of it are two boxes: the light brown one has a {item:Minotaur Leather} waiting for you.
There is a suspicious raft south of Thais, guarded by minotaurs.
On the way south of Thais you may meet {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears}; the raft is guarded by {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}.
Leave **Thais** and walk **south** to the raft ({coord:32302,32416,7}). You do not need a boat or special equipment to get there.
The raft is guarded by {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs}. Kill them or drive them away before opening the boxes.
On the raft there are two boxes. Open the **light brown** box to receive the {item:Minotaur Leather}.
To leave, go back to **Thais** on foot the same way, to the **north**. Beware of the {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears} on the way.
